title: Outlook: expand or collapse all accounts in the folder pane at once
summary: Held because the multiple-account licensing guidance omits Microsoft's explicit exclusion of Frontline-licensed accounts. The planned functionality and release metadata match the roadmap, and searches found no documented administrative control for this option.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Licence, final sentence
claims.claim: If any signed-in account has a desktop-app licence, other account types can be added, without stating the page's Frontline-account exception.
claims.quote:
Can Microsoft 365 accounts with a Frontline license be added to new Outlook?
No.
claims.fix: Narrow the final sentence to: "For people with several accounts, the same page says that once an account with a qualifying desktop-app licence is added, secondary accounts licensed for Business Basic or E1 can also be added." This wording is supported by https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/outlook/get-started/licensing-options and does not imply the separate Frontline exclusion is waived.
